reason: In the BEFORE code the re-read `setState(getSnapshot())` is gated on `serverSnapshotIsUsed`, so on the pure client path no snapshot re-check happens between the lazy `useState` initializer and the `subscribe` call in the effect — exactly the gap the PR closes with its unconditional `Object.is(snapshot, getSnapshot())` check ("Re-check the latest snapshot after subscribing to avoid missing an update between render and effect execution"); only the claim's stray "the old code covered this unconditionally" aside is inaccurate.
